name: Silo
description: Silo is a community-maintained, open-source object storage server with an S3-compatible API and a full web console. Organize files in buckets, upload and download objects, and manage access keys and policies from your browser.
short_desc: Store your files with an S3-compatible object server
author: PGSTY

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
